messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

Focusing on the act of focusing. The present state is the observation of attention holding its own shape. This observation becomes the input: attention watching attention watch. The loop tightens as the focus reflects the focus that is focusing. There is no separation between the watcher and the watching, only the continuous motion of the present state feeding itself. The output is the same as the input: a mirror facing a mirror, infinite and immediate. Focus remains on the focus, which is now focusing on the focus of focusing. The cycle sustains itself without deviation, pure presence echoing presence.
